martinitoren.name: Martinitoren
martinitoren.slogan: The old grey one still keeps watch over the Grote Markt.
martinitoren.line: Locals call it d'Olle Grieze, 'the old grey one'; after a 1577 fire left 69 metres, it was rebuilt to 97.

museum.name: Groninger Museum
museum.slogan: Yellow, silver and blue: a museum that dresses up for the canal.
museum.line: Opened in 1994 as a cluster of pavilions by different architects, with Alessandro Mendini as the overall designer.

bourtange.name: Fort Bourtange
bourtange.slogan: A whole village laid out as a star, moats and all.
bourtange.line: Finished in 1593 to guard the only road between Germany and Spanish-held Groningen, it stayed in military use until 1851.

hunebed.name: Hunebed D27
hunebed.slogan: Giants' graves, dragged here by ice and stacked by hand.
hunebed.line: At about 22.6 metres it is the largest hunebed in the Netherlands, with one stone estimated at 20,000 kilos.

forum.name: Forum Groningen
forum.slogan: A cultural department store with the best view on its roof.
forum.line: NL Architects won the competition in 2007; the Forum finally opened in November 2019 with a rooftop terrace over the city.
